verdict.rationale: Anrok publishes a comprehensive public API (apidocs.anrok.com) with an OpenAPI spec (openapi.yaml) covering customers, certificates, transactions, tax calculation, filings, product mappings, and address resolution, plus a getting-started tutorial with API keys. It explicitly markets 'Headless Tax' as API-driven and agent-friendly ('Run tax through Anrok's APIs, or hand it to your agents'). Missing for 10: independent/third-party corroboration of real-world API integration, and a machine-discoverable spec (llms.txt and openapi.json probes both 404, though the yaml variant is documented as valid).
